title: 16. How do I create a new survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I create a new survey.
short_answer: On the 'Welcome' page or the 'Surveys' page, click on 'New Survey' 'Create new Survey' option and a dialogue box will open. Once you have entered all mandatory information, click on 'Create'. The application will load your new survey into the system and open the 'Editor' automatically, so you can start adding elements to your survey right away.
